title: 十一点五十分的挂号信  (Ten Minutes to Twelve)

segments.t: Inside at the front desk at eleven fifty, Manager Zhou straightens his clean blue tie while Qing and Mei watch the clock—right as the postman leaves a thick white envelope on the counter. Listen first.
小晴，今天我的领带怎么样？一滴橙汁都没有！
笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
说这话的人每隔三十秒就扒着窗帘偷看一次！
我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
说得对。公事等一等——先放在账本旁边。
我把蓝色行李箱放在树下志豪桌子边了。
茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
Now let's walk through the scene, one line at a time.
笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
'Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.' Framing a surprising detail uses
连
paired with 'all/even'—'even your glasses are on your nose!'.
有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
'Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!' Encouraging two-character word
进步
literally 'advance a step', means 'progress' or 'improvement'.
我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
'I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?' Sealed letters and envelopes use
封
originally 'seal up', as their dedicated counting word.
邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
'The postman just had me sign for it; it carries a red property-office stamp.' Delivery compound
签收
squeezes 'sign to acknowledge receipt' into two brisk syllables.
房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
'Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.' Essential housing word:
房租
joins 'house/room' with 'rent', while its owner is 'house-east'—the landlord.
十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
'Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to twelve!' Telling time before the hour uses
差
meaning 'short by': 'short five minutes twelve o'clock' for eleven fifty-five.
说得对。公事等一等——先放在账本旁边。
'Right you are. Paperwork can wait—set it beside the ledger for now.' Instant agreement:
说得对
says 'spoken rightly'—'you're quite right!'.
听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！

'Listen... the clock tower at the end of the street is starting to strike twelve!' Bell strokes take the same brief-action counter you met in Episode 1: 'strike twelve strokes'. Now let's hear the whole scene again without stopping.
小晴，今天我的领带怎么样？一滴橙汁都没有！
笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
说这话的人每隔三十秒就扒着窗帘偷看一次！
我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
说得对。公事等一等——先放在账本旁边。
我把蓝色行李箱放在树下志豪桌子边了。
茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
That thick envelope with the red property stamp sits unopened beside the ledger as the street clock tower begins chiming twelve. Let's step out to the gate next time. See you next time.
回头见！
